title: Recitation correction in pairs: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 26 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recitation correction in pairs rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 26. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: a major mistake that changes a letter or vowel
a minor mistake in a tajweed rule

questions.q: The teacher reads 87:14 with one mistake. Spot it and correct it kindly.
questions.a: The teacher said 'aflaha' without the qalqalah on qad: the correction is to bounce the د.

questions.q: Pairs in breakout rooms: take turns to recite Al-A'la 87:1 to 19 to your partner, who uses the checklist. The teacher visits each room.
questions.a: Each pupil recites; partner ticks, praises and gives one kind correction.

questions.q: Extend: write your partner's one target in their pupil PDF.
questions.a: For example: 'Hold the madd in شَآءَ for four counts.'

questions.q: Saying ق as ك in «خَلَقَ» is ...
options: a major mistake: it changes a letter
questions.a: A) a major mistake: it changes a letter. Changing a letter is a major (jali) mistake.

questions.q: When should you correct your partner?
options: In the middle of a word

questions.q: Think again: If your friend makes a mistake in recitation, how can you tell them without making them feel bad?
questions.a: Wait until they finish the ayah, say the right word gently, praise what was good, and help them try again.
